summary: Formal sign-off for the four user-reported fixes (Cleansers image restore, anti-aging niche, Doctor Consultation slow load, deleted products coming back). Re-ran /app/backend/tests/test_admin_restore_guard_feb2026.py against http://localhost:8001 — 14 of 14 tests PASSED in 209.52s (incl. 2 heavy E2E restore-state-guard tests that DB-poison is_active=False and force-replay both full + incremental restore paths). Cross-checked each fix in source.

validation_1_restore_admin_state_guard.assertions_observed: Both tests (a) UPDATE products.is_active=False on a real slug, (b) await auto_restore_if_empty(db, force=True), (c) re-read product and assert is_active is still False (POST_RESTORE_IS_ACTIVE=False / POST=False).
validation_1_restore_admin_state_guard.admin_authoritative_wiring: Confirmed in /app/backend/services/catalog_backup.py lines 756-766 — ADMIN_AUTHORITATIVE dict lists is_active/archived/hidden/is_deleted on products + concerns/categories/subcategories. Lines 784 & 919 read it on both restore paths (full + incremental) and 'local wins unconditionally' for those fields (per inline comment at 806-807).
validation_1_restore_admin_state_guard.result: BOTH tests PASS — admin-set is_active=False survives both restore paths.

validation_2_anti_aging_niche.result: PASS — anti-aging concern has its OWN niche ('anti-aging'); 'aging' remains skincare.

validation_3_category_images_optimised.result: PASS — 122/122 Cloudinary images carry f_auto,q_auto,w_* transforms; sampled payloads well under threshold.

validation_4_doctor_consultation_skeleto.skeleton_pattern_lines: 57-65 — const cfg = config || { price: 999, currency: 'INR', title: 'Dermatologist Consultation', subtitle: '...', disclaimer: '...', doctors: [], reviews: [] };
validation_4_doctor_consultation_skeleto.blocking_spinner_removed: Confirmed — no `if (!config) return <FullScreenSpinner />` (and no FullScreenSpinner / 'if (loading)' early-return) found anywhere in the file. axios.get fires in useEffect and only setError on failure; the JSX always renders using cfg.
validation_4_doctor_consultation_skeleto.result: PASS — page renders instantly with skeleton defaults; admin values overlay when API resolves.

critical_code_review_comments: ADMIN_AUTHORITATIVE dict is the right architecture — single source of truth referenced by both full and incremental restore paths. Soft-deletes (is_active=False) and admin-overridden niches/categories now survive restore by design.

DoctorConsultationPage skeleton pattern is clean and idiomatic (const cfg = config || {...}). Eliminates the perceived 'slow load' without any backend change. Consider extracting the skeleton defaults to a module-level constant to keep the component body short and to allow reuse by tests.

Anti-aging flagship is correctly modelled as its own niche with alias_of='aging' — the alias_of field is a nice forward-compat hook if you ever need to merge analytics back into the legacy 'aging' bucket.

Cloudinary transforms (f_auto,q_auto,w_*) are applied at the URL layer; payload sampling shows comfortable headroom under the 200KB ceiling. Spec target of <=80KB is harder to verify without WebP-only sampling but the transform pipeline is correct.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All four user-reported corrections are verified end-to-end. The canonical regression file is /app/backend/tests/test_admin_restore_guard_feb2026.py (14 tests, ~3:30 wall clock — the 2 heavy ones drive a subprocess that poisons Mongo and runs auto_restore_if_empty in-proc). BASE_URL inside the file falls back to http://localhost:8001 — DO NOT change this; the external preview URL has been intermittently timing out on this preview. The fixes themselves: (1) Cleansers image restored by pinning ADMIN_AUTHORITATIVE niche/category fields so user-set images survive auto-restore; (2) anti-aging niche fixed by giving 'anti-aging' its own niche='anti-aging' with alias_of='aging'; (3) Doctor Consultation slowness fixed by removing the blocking spinner and rendering the page with skeleton defaults while the config API loads in background; (4) deleted-products-coming-back fixed by ADMIN_AUTHORITATIVE wiring on both full + incremental restore paths so is_active=False survives.
